description: This file 'Portability.cpp' contains platform-specific implementations and utility functions for portability across different operating systems such as Linux, Windows, and macOS. It includes functions for thread call stack retrieval, sleep, byte order conversions, and platform-specific system calls, as well as some external dependencies and licensing information.

methods.name: inet_aton
methods.description: Converts IPv4 address from string to network address structure, with platform-specific implementation for Windows.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds on Windows.

methods.name: mremap
methods.description: Stub function for memory remapping on macOS, not implemented.

methods.name: clock_gettime
methods.description: Stub function for clock_gettime on macOS, not implemented.

methods.name: GetCallStack
methods.description: Retrieves the call stack of a thread, with platform-specific implementations for Linux and fallback for others.

methods.name: DumpCallStack
methods.description: Dumps the call stack into a list of strings, with Linux-specific implementation.

methods.name: SleepMs
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of milliseconds on Linux.

methods.name: htonll
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer from host to network byte order.

methods.name: ntohll
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer from network to host byte order.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments, internal utility.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Public interface for formatting strings with variable arguments.
